name: TYX blaster
description: The TYX blaster was a model of small blaster, one of which was owned by the droid 4-LOM. 4-LOM once brought his TYX blaster to Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel, where he concealed it from the diner's bouncer before firing a volley of shots toward the crime lord Mozeen Parapa.
